3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Standing on a remote mountain plateau outside of Naeal, the Silver Garrison was the headquarters of the Derdian government as well as the dwelling place of its leader, Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: For our meeting today, Azmal had granted me the rare permission to enter his inner sanctum.

5.speaker: Sal Ignacius
5.text: "These are Seekers, Your Majesty. It is said that through their physical labor, they will gain the mental clarity they need to begin their pursuit of Golconda."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "They do all the dirty work while the 'true believers' lounge around doing nothing. Sounds like a scam."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "May the Lord bless them and guide them on their spiritual journey."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "And the fact that there are no men among them is... coincidence?"

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "So you're saying that if we replace our palace maids with Golcondists, we won't have to pay them?"

16.speaker: Sal Ignacius
16.text: "The work of the Disciples and Adepts is no less rigorous, Your Majesty. But yes, the Seeker role is particularly thankless."

17.speaker: Sal Ignacius
17.text: "Not at all, Your Majesty. Women in Derdian Golcondist communities are often limited to the Seeker role, while men are permitted to advance."

18.speaker: Sal Ignacius
18.text: "It will be a long one. Few women are ever allowed to progress past the Seeker role."

19.speaker: Sal Ignacius
19.text: "A Seeker's work is only holy when performed on behalf of the entire community, Your Majesty."

20.speaker: Titus Gordion
20.text: "I think His Majesty was joking, sir."

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: As the guards led us closer to the pillar, the sound of men's voices could be heard. Short, sharp shouts, emitted in perfect unison.

22.speaker: Jorga Azmal
22.text: "Welcome to the Silver Garrison, Your Majesty."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Thank you for the demonstration, Supreme Wiseman. The skill of your Disciples is admirable indeed."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: A gong chimed in the distance. Almost instantly, the Disciples spread out to form a perfect circle around us.

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "I am humbled to be here, Mr. Azmal."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "No time for dance moves. I need to talk to you now."

29.speaker: Jorga Azmal
29.text: "The honor is mine. Never before has any king of Rizia been such a friend to the Golcondists."

37.speaker: Jorga Azmal
37.text: "Coming from such a friend to the Golcondists, your words honor me."

38.speaker: Jorga Azmal
38.text: "They still have far to go. But thank you."

43.speaker: Jorga Azmal
43.text: "They still have far to go. But thank you."

44.speaker: Jorga Azmal
44.text: "We must always be prepared for battle, Your Majesty. But I don't have to tell you that."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "You're speaking to Romus the Generous here. Bring it on."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "I know better than to engage Golcondists in a duel, Mr. Supreme Wiseman."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "It would be a great privilege to participate in your holy tradition."

51.speaker: Sal Ignacius
51.text: "I have read of this ceremony, Your Majesty. It is a polite show of skill, not an all-out fight."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: The circle of men flattened out into a long line. Azmal slowly walked from one end to the other, then back to the middle.

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: He stood in front of a particularly tall, well-built Disciple and bowed. The man took a step forward and returned the gesture.

56.speaker: Jorga Azmal
56.text: "Correct, Grand Wiseman. No weapons, no bloodshed. Each leader represented by a champion of his choosing."

58.speaker: Jorga Azmal
58.text: "Captain Gordion. I have heard tales of your fighting prowess, both before and after you began serving the King."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "I have. Captain Gordion shall represent me in the Duel of Generosity."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "No. I will serve as my own champion."

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "Actually... I'm not comfortable with this. May we pray instead?"

62.speaker: Jorga Azmal
62.text: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. I understand that the way we do things in Derdia is rather... unorthodox to non-Golcondists."

63.speaker: Jorga Azmal
63.text: "I will be represented by Loran. His participation in this duel shall be his final challenge before his ascension to the rank of Adept."

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: The rest of the Disciples applauded. Sal politely followed suit.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Azmal turned towards Titus. My bodyguard tensed up instinctively.

66.speaker: Jorga Azmal
66.text: "Am I right to assume that you have brought this man as your champion, Your Majesty?"

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Everyone went silent for a second.

68.speaker: Titus Gordion
68.text: "Your Majesty... This man looks like trouble. Even for me."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: Sal nudged Titus forward. The captain bowed.

70.speaker: Titus Gordion
70.text: "Yes. I will do my best to make the Crown proud, sir."

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: Azmal shook his head in disappointment. The fighter he'd chosen reluctantly stepped back into line.

75.speaker: Jorga Azmal
75.text: "You do not respect Derdians in your country. It makes sense that you would not respect us in ours."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "He wouldn't dare hurt the King of Rizia. I'm safe."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "With my military training, this will be a piece of cake."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "I've got to respect my hosts, right? What could be more respectful than stepping into the ring myself?"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I've really been wanting to punch something lately, Titus. Just let me have this."

83.speaker: Jorga Azmal
83.text: "Excellent. I am looking forward to witnessing a Rizian Golden Guard in action."

84.speaker: Jorga Azmal
84.text: "Each fighter will now have five minutes to prepare."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: Loran nodded his assent and walked away. He knelt on a patch of grass and raised his arms skyward in prayer, his face a mask of concentration.

86.speaker: Titus Gordion
86.text: "All right. But let me know if you need help."

87.speaker: Titus Gordion
87.text: "I don't mean to doubt your capabilities. I will be standing at the ready in case you need backup."

88.speaker: Titus Gordion
88.text: "Be careful. With his build, even an accidentally landed hit could prove deadly."

89.speaker: Titus Gordion
89.text: "If you insist, sir. I will be standing at the ready in case you need help."

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: Titus removed his blazer. He performed a few stretches and started throwing practice jabs in the air.

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "Don't pull any punches, Captain Gordion. Show Derdia what a real fighter looks like."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "I know you can take him, Titus. But I want you to let him win."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "Why aren't you praying? The other guy is praying."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Remember, the stars of St. Wruhec shine on you alone. Now pray to God for success in battle."

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: He knelt on the ground and began murmuring prayers.

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: A short while later, another gong sounded. The Disciples formed a tight circle around Titus and the man Jorga Azmal had called Loran.

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: The Supreme Wiseman stepped between them.

114.speaker: Jorga Azmal
114.text: "The duel will last 10 minutes, or until one opponent acknowledges the other's superior skill in combat. Should a fighter draw blood, the duel will be called off immediately, its results void before the Lord."

115.speaker: Jorga Azmal
115.text: "You will bow to one another, and the duel will commence."

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: He stepped back into the circle. He and the Disciples began a slow, deep-voiced chant in Derdian as Titus and Loran bowed to one another.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: The moment they began sparring, it was obvious how evenly matched they were.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: The Derdian fighter moved with a fluid unpredictability; Titus with sharp, deliberate precision. Every strike was met with a parry; every advance with a retreat.

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: I snuck a look at Jorga Azmal. The Supreme Wiseman seemed utterly spellbound by the spectacle unfolding before us.

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: Suddenly, I heard a cry of pain. Titus was doubled over on the ground, clutching his side just below his ribcage.

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: Loran, looking dumbfounded, reached a hand down to help. Titus swatted it away and lurched unsteadily to his feet. He had a look in his eyes that bordered on feral.

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: Something seemed to snap in my bodyguard. He became a whirlwind of fists and feet, landing blow after blow on his Derdian opponent.

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: Loran weakly held his hands in front of his face, attempting to concede. Titus ignored him and delivered a final, brutal punch to the jaw.

129.speaker: Narrator
129.text: Titus looked at me and nodded weakly. He put up both of his hands.

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: Titus and Loran stepped away from each other, looking confused. Azmal signaled to the circle to stop chanting.

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: Titus and Loran stared each other down for a moment, then resumed their dance, this time with a slightly more aggressive edge.

132.speaker: Jorga Azmal
132.text: "I don't understand. It was just a light jab..."

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: Azmal signaled for the chanting to stop. He and his champion looked at each other, their triumph mixed with confusion.

134.speaker: Narrator
134.text: The ten minutes were nearing their end. With a glance at me, Titus gracefully feinted to the right just in time for his opponent to land a forceful blow to his jaw.

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: The ten minutes were nearing their end. With a glance at me, Titus casually switched his stance from right to left, throwing his opponent off guard and allowing him to land a decisive blow to the jaw.

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: The ten minutes were nearing their end. With a glance at me, Titus switched his stance from right to left -- a surprise move, designed to throw his opponent off guard.

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: Loran shook it off and smiled. He held both hands up in the air, signalling his concession.

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: He shook it off with a smile and held both hands up in the air, signalling his concession.

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: With disappointment in his eyes, Titus held both hands up in the air, signalling his concession.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: Azmal signaled for the circle to stop chanting. He applauded.

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: The Derdian staggered backwards. He spat out a blood-covered tooth before collapsing to the ground.

149.speaker: Narrator
149.text: The chanting ceased and the circle broke apart. Azmal rushed to his champion's side.

150.speaker: Jorga Azmal
150.text: "The Lord has blessed us with a beautiful fight."

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: Azmal signaled for the circle to stop chanting. He stepped in and gleefully applauded.

152.speaker: Jorga Azmal
152.text: "The Lord has blessed us with a beautiful fight. This bodes well for our two countries."

153.speaker: Jorga Azmal
153.text: "Your performance was beyond expectations, my champion. You will make a fine Adept."

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: He took his disciple's hands and kissed him tenderly on the lips. The surrounding crowd erupted into cheers.

155.speaker: Jorga Azmal
155.text: "Loran, you may not have won, but you are still my champion. You will make a fine Adept."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "You've got that right. Every last one of them is going to hell."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "It's not my cup of tea. But I won't disparage their culture."

159.speaker: Sal Ignacius
159.text: "St. Wruhec would despair at what they have done to his sacred teachings. Do you not agree, Your Majesty?"

160.speaker: Sal Ignacius
160.text: "In a way, you are right. It is like watching two giraffes' necks entwine in the royal zoo."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Personally, I find the glorification of violence more disturbing than the sight of two men smooching."

162.speaker: Sal Ignacius
162.text: "It is no culture. It is a mockery of Wruhecist values."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "I am sorry, Supreme Wiseman. My champion behaved disgracefully."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Your champion played dirty, Mr. Azmal. He doesn't deserve to become an Adept."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Your man played dirty, Mr. Azmal. He doesn't deserve to become an Adept."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Would you like a kiss as well, Titus?"

181.speaker: Sal Ignacius
181.text: "A small preview of what Rizia shall become now that such affections are legal in our country."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "And quite rightly so. It doesn't go against the teachings of St. Wruhec for a man to love another man."

183.speaker: Sal Ignacius
183.text: "It is not history's judgement I am worried about. It is that of God."

184.speaker: Sal Ignacius
184.text: "In most interpretations, it does. The Golcondists' belief in the sanctity of same-sex bonds is quite... unorthodox."

186.speaker: Sal Ignacius
186.text: "I would not use that precise word."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "I have made Rizia a better, more enlightened place. History will vindicate me."

188.speaker: Jorga Azmal
188.text: "Dirty? It was a light jab. No worse than the hits your Golden Guard was landing."

190.speaker: Titus Gordion
190.text: "I was taken by surprise and I broke the rules. Please forgive me, Your Majesty."

191.speaker: Titus Gordion
191.text: "I was taken by surprise. Forgive me, both of you."

192.speaker: Titus Gordion
192.text: "Forgive me, both of you. I was taken by surprise."

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: Azmal frowned. He turned to Loran.

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "Forgive me, Supreme Wiseman. I got carried away."

198.speaker: Titus Gordion
198.text: "No, it's my fault. I was taken by surprise and I broke the rules."

199.speaker: Titus Gordion
199.text: "Not your man's fault, Supreme Wiseman. I was taken by surprise."

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: He raised an arm, and the Disciples began dispersing.

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: But he completed it too slowly. The fraction of a second was just long enough for Loran to land a decisive blow to his jaw.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: We turned our attention back to Azmal. The Disciples had begun to disperse.

209.speaker: Sal Ignacius
209.text: "Both are a mockery of Wruhecist values."

212.speaker: Jorga Azmal
212.text: "Don't despair, my champion. The day of your ascent will soon come."

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: Loran sat up in a daze. Azmal signaled for a pair of Disciples to lead him away.

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: He stood up and brushed off his robe imperiously.

218.speaker: Jorga Azmal
218.text: "Not an auspicious start to our meeting, Your Majesty. But I will give you and your captain the benefit of the doubt."

219.speaker: Jorga Azmal
219.text: "You wanted to talk, we will talk. But your brute must stay outside."

220.speaker: Jorga Azmal
220.text: "Today is not your day, my champion. But your ascent will soon come."

224.speaker: Jorga Azmal
224.text: "I apologize, Your Majesty. This was not an auspicious start to our meeting."

225.speaker: Jorga Azmal
225.text: "You wanted to talk, we will talk. Quickly."

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: The Disciples began dispersing. Azmal beckoned for me to come with him.

227.speaker: Jorga Azmal
227.text: "An auspicious start to our meeting. This way, please."

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: Titus stood outside as Sal and I followed the Supreme Wiseman through a door at the base of the pillar.

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: A staircase led down to a softly lit room, its walls lined floor to ceiling with bookshelves.

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "The PM of Morella has asked me to speak to you regarding Derdia's violation of her country's borders."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "I wish to strengthen the ties between our two nations."

237.speaker: Jorga Azmal
237.text: "Your Majesty, I hope you know that I will not exchange a single favor with you until Derdians are once more allowed into your kingdom."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "The ban is only in place as part of an agreement I made with Wehlen. As soon as we get Zille back, I will lift it."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "The ban is not directed towards Derdia. I want to keep Rizia safe from the Bludish terrorists you might be harboring."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "I can't do that. Your 'pilgrims' must be kept as far away as possible from our holy sites."

244.speaker: Jorga Azmal
244.text: "I will not settle for promises. You are asking me to act immediately. I want the same from you."

245.speaker: Jorga Azmal
245.text: "I see you are falling for Wehlen's lies."

246.speaker: Jorga Azmal
246.text: "And why is that? Our countrypeople pray to the same God."

247.speaker: Jorga Azmal
247.text: "The Bluds who enter Derdia are themselves victims of Wiktor Smolak's reign of terror. As a fellow Wruhecist, are you not obligated to help them?"

248.speaker: Sal Ignacius
248.text: "With all respect, Supreme Wiseman, our religions are not the same. Your barbaric fighting ceremony proved that."

249.speaker: Sal Ignacius
249.text: "Please understand, Supreme Wiseman. There are good people living in Zille who will suffer if our promises to Wehlen are broken."

250.speaker: Jorga Azmal
250.text: "And the Bluds who are suffering now? Do you consider them less worthy?"

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "There must be something else you want. Gold? Energy?"

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "Now, Sal. I would not go as far as to say 'barbaric'."

253.speaker: Jorga Azmal
253.text: "No. Only as far as to think it."

254.speaker: Jorga Azmal
254.text: "This is non-negotiable, Your Majesty. Lift your Golcondist border ban, and we can talk."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Not to mention your acceptance of sinful man-on-man relations."

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: "What happened to tolerance, Grand Wiseman Ignacius? Rizia and Derdia must be willing to accept each other's differences."

260.speaker: Jorga Azmal
260.text: "I would argue that accepting love in all its forms is a more generous interpretation of St. Wruhec than what you Rizians believe."

261.speaker: Jorga Azmal
261.text: "But before that, we must accept each other's citizens."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "I cannot. You have my sincerest regrets."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "Are you trying to give the King of Rizia orders? Do you take me for one of your goddamn Disciples?"

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "Very well. I will have the border ban on Derdian citizens lifted. But I still can't allow in Bluds from Wehlen."

268.speaker: Narrator
268.text: Azmal stood up. He stared at me coldly.

269.speaker: Jorga Azmal
269.text: "My Disciples are men of compassion. You, Romus Toras, are not."

270.speaker: Jorga Azmal
270.text: "Then I'm afraid we are done here."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: Azmal stood up. He stared at me coldly.

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "All right. If it will help, I will allow all Golcondists into Rizia once more."

283.speaker: Jorga Azmal
283.text: "However, we still have to discuss the acceptance of Golcondists into Rizia's Wruhecist holy sites."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "Of course not. In fact, we are allied with one of the Bludish Freedom Front's biggest supporters."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "I do believe that Derdians practice the one true form of Golcondism. The Bludish version is invalid in my eyes."

288.speaker: Jorga Azmal
288.text: "Rumburg? Your sister-in-law and her fellow Dastnurists seek to exploit the Bluds for their own gain, not support them."

292.speaker: Jorga Azmal
292.text: "I beg to differ, There are few enough of us Golcondists that I hold each Bludish and Derdian life sacred."

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "I care for the lives of my citizens, as you care for yours. Surely we can reach a compromise."

294.speaker: Jorga Azmal
294.text: "There will be no compromise as long as Rizia is still closed off to us."

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: There were no tables or chairs, just a number of comfortable-looking cushions on the carpeted floor. Azmal gestured for us to sit.

296.speaker: Jorga Azmal
296.text: "This is the very heart of the Garrison, Your Majesty. I never make a political decision without consulting the teachings of St. Wruhec."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "Wruhec's writings have indeed kept their relevance, even in our present day."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "I would not presume to have your religious wisdom. But I do often seek the advice of Grand Wiseman Ignacius."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "I spend my time listening to my people, Supreme Wiseman. Not saints who died centuries ago."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "I do the same. One cannot steer the course of a nation without a spiritual compass."

308.speaker: Jorga Azmal
308.text: "Are there any of his tracts that you find particularly useful?"

310.speaker: Jorga Azmal
310.text: "A mistake. The will of the people is capricious, while the wisdom of saints is eternal."

315.speaker: Narrator
315.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn01_Briefing_Religious_CeremonyParticipated"] == false) == false

318.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
318.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn01_Briefing_Religious_CeremonyParticipated"] == false) == false

319.speaker: Sal Ignacius
319.text: "We in Rizia find that the dual burden of spiritual and political leadership is too great for one soul to shoulder alone."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "I cannot choose just one. It's like asking me to pick a favorite child."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "To be honest, I've been too busy with state matters to spend time perusing scripture."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "I like St. Wruhec's older teachings. You wouldn't have heard of them."

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "I don't read St. Wruhec's writings myself. I rely on my Grand Wiseman to interpret them for me."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "Right now, I'm finding solace in 'Armaments of Faith: A Treatise on Battle Preparedness'."
327.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Religious"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "Currently, I'm finding solace in 'Peace's Testament: On Sacred Nonviolence'."
331.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Religious"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

333.speaker: Jorga Azmal
333.text: "Ah, yes. An excellent choice for your current situation."

334.speaker: Jorga Azmal
334.text: "Naturally. I knew your kingdom's attempt to stay the course of peace in the face of threats was divinely guided."

338.speaker: Jorga Azmal
338.text: "However, in your shameful treatment of Golcondists, I feel you have let some of our beloved saint's teachings fall by the wayside."

339.speaker: Jorga Azmal
339.text: "For every situation, there is a different treatise, Your Majesty."

343.speaker: Jorga Azmal
343.text: "I would suggest you read 'On the Embrace of Divine Differences'. It might lead you to treat Golcondists differently in your country."

344.speaker: Jorga Azmal
344.text: "A mistake, Your Majesty. There is always something to learn from scripture, especially in the midst of chaos."

345.speaker: Jorga Azmal
345.text: "I know all of his teachings, Your Majesty. Down to the semicolon."

346.speaker: Jorga Azmal
346.text: "However, if it was your people who led you to remove your predecessor's ridiculous blasphemy law, then I must commend them for their judgement."

347.speaker: Jorga Azmal
347.text: "Perhaps it was 'On the Embrace of Divine Differences' that led you to remove your predecessor's nonsensical blasphemy law."

352.speaker: Jorga Azmal
352.text: "You must also have been influenced by 'On the Embrace of Divine Differences' when you removed your predecessor's nonsensical blasphemy law."

356.speaker: Jorga Azmal
356.text: "I'm afraid your Grand Wiseman has been giving you flawed advice. I don't know how else to explain the treatment of Golcondists in your country."

357.speaker: Jorga Azmal
357.text: "Your Grand Wiseman has advised you well, Your Majesty. Especially on the lifting of your predecessor's ridiculous blasphemy law."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "Our border ban on Bluds and Derdians was not religiously motivated. It was a necessary political concession to Wehlen."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "Our blasphemy laws were passed to protect Rizian Wruhecists' right to observe in peace. I will not apologize for putting my countrypeople's rights before yours."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "You act as if Golcondists are innocent victims. As if you haven't been involved in insurgency and terrorism."

367.speaker: Jorga Azmal
367.text: "Is it 'terrorism' to protect one's right to exist? 'Insurgency' to break the chains that our oppressors have placed on us?"

368.speaker: Jorga Azmal
368.text: "Even worse. You are placating Wiktor Smolak, a man who denies Golcondists the right to exist in his country."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "How dare you presume to educate me on Wruhec's teachings, when your fanatical sect makes a mockery of them?"

373.speaker: Jorga Azmal
373.text: "You agreed to meet with me. I will assume you did so in pursuit of a mutually beneficial arrangement between our countries."

374.speaker: Jorga Azmal
374.text: "Wruhec and his disciples traveled these lands long before our borders existed, Your Majesty. A worshipper's place of birth should not prohibit him from following the divine path."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "I came up with that idea on my own. I confess it has not made me very popular."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "National borders should not be an obstacle in the path of the devout. That's just common sense."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "Your so-called pilgrims were illegally occupying our sacred place of prayer. What else could I have done?"

381.speaker: Jorga Azmal
381.text: "They were hurting no one. You could have left them in peace."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "Perhaps I have been harsh on Golcondists in the past. I am willing to make amends."

384.speaker: Jorga Azmal
384.text: "Your words will only have meaning when they are followed with actions."

385.speaker: Jorga Azmal
385.text: "It is you who are mocking our saint by refusing to accept the beliefs of others."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "It was the Lord Himself who came to me in a vision and told me to make that decree."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "I do not agree with all aspects of your religion. But I will not interfere with your freedom to practice it."

394.speaker: Jorga Azmal
394.text: "The path of the righteous is not always an easy one, Your Majesty."

395.speaker: Jorga Azmal
395.text: "I will say that I do not approve of your participation in the persecution of our Golcondist brethren in Wehlen."

399.speaker: Jorga Azmal
399.text: "I am puzzled that you grant special favors to women in your country while forbidding men to express love for one another."
399.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_EqualPayMenWomen"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true)

406.speaker: Jorga Azmal
406.text: "We may not agree on everything. But I nonetheless see fertile ground for cooperation, where previously there was barrenness."
406.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_EqualPayMenWomen"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Drugs_Banned"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false)

407.speaker: Jorga Azmal
407.text: "I assume you came to meet me in pursuit of a mutually beneficial arrangement. So tell me, what does Rizia want?"

409.speaker: Jorga Azmal
409.text: "The Archsanctuaries of Plavo, Benievon, and Jales are three of the most sacred sites in the Wruhecist religion. It is not fair that my people are denied access to them."

410.speaker: Sal Ignacius
410.text: "When you were allowed to enter them, you crowded out the *real* Wruhecists. To the point of damaging one of our precious sanctuaries."

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "We granted Derdians full working rights in Rizia. Doesn't that make up for not being allowed into some creaky old buildings?"

415.speaker: Jorga Azmal
415.text: "It shows that Rizia accepts Derdians only as laborers, not as human beings."

416.speaker: Jorga Azmal
416.text: "My people have mined your gold, built your weapons, extracted your gas. Yet they are barred from their religion's holiest of places?"

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "Your people are guests in our country, Supreme Wiseman. They shouldn't abuse their privileges."

418.speaker: Jorga Azmal
418.text: "What privileges? You only invite Derdians into Rizia to do the work that your own people claim is beneath them."

419.speaker: Jorga Azmal
419.text: "Still, I am pleased that you lifted your predecessor's ridiculous blasphemy law. Whether or not you were divinely motivated to do so."

420.speaker: Jorga Azmal
420.text: "What is it that you would ask of me?"

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "If your people want to partake in our prosperity, they must assimilate. Those who seek freedom of religion are welcome to return to Derdia."

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "At least Derdians in Rizia are compensated for their labor. How many years must one toil as one of your Seekers before seeing a cent of wages?"

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: "It is not Derdian laborers we are worried about. It is holy pilgrims."

425.speaker: Jorga Azmal
425.text: "It is forbidden for a Seeker to do work that enriches another. They only toil on behalf of themselves and their own community."

430.speaker: Jorga Azmal
430.text: "Laborer and pilgrim alike pray to the same God, Your Majesty. You cannot judge Derdians only by the value they provide to your kingdom."

431.speaker: Jorga Azmal
431.text: "If you wish to limit the flow of visitors to your Archsanctuaries, we will not oppose that."

432.speaker: Jorga Azmal
432.text: "I know the strife Rizia is facing. If you would see reason and lift this unjust ban, there is much we in Derdia can do to help you."

433.speaker: Player_Romus
433.text: "You speak of us as though we are a charity case. Is it not Derdia that has been clamoring to end its international isolation?"

434.speaker: Jorga Azmal
434.text: "A truly prosperous kingdom respects the beliefs of all who dwell there, Your Majesty."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "A 'true path' that involves the oppression of women."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Doesn't enlightenment through violence directly contradict Wruhec's teachings?"

441.speaker: Jorga Azmal
441.text: "Go outside, Your Majesty. Ask the women in my community if they feel oppressed."

442.speaker: Sal Ignacius
442.text: "Who are we? We are custodians of the resting places of St. Wruhec's most cherished disciples. Therefore, we decide who enters."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "We face no strife, Supreme Wiseman. When we conquer Pales, Rizia will be stronger and more prosperous than ever."

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "We face no strife, Supreme Wiseman. When Zille is returned to us, Rizia will be stronger and more prosperous than ever."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "Can you promise that your people will respect the rule of law in Rizia? Whether or not it clashes with Golcondism?"

449.speaker: Player_Romus
449.text: "Can you ensure that your people will respect our holy buildings? They belong to all Wruhecists, after all."

451.speaker: Jorga Azmal
451.text: "I see there is no getting through to you."

452.speaker: Jorga Azmal
452.text: "I cannot control what Derdians do in your country. But I will help you preserve order at the three Archsanctuaries to the extent that I am able."

453.speaker: Narrator
453.text: Sal looked at me with warning in his eyes.

454.speaker: Sal Ignacius
454.text: "You tread a dangerous path, Your Majesty. I do not know whether Rizia can tolerate an influx of Golcondists -- especially during wartime."

458.speaker: Sal Ignacius
458.text: "You tread a dangerous path, Your Majesty. I do not know whether Rizia can tolerate an influx of Golcondists."

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "I unfortunately have no choice. Mr. Azmal, I will nullify our blasphemy laws in exchange for your country's aid." [-4 Authority]

460.speaker: Jorga Azmal
460.text: "But I suspect your law has never been only about overcrowding."

461.speaker: Jorga Azmal
461.text: "No? Did he not once proclaim, 'Love, in all its forms, is the Lord's gift to humanity. Let no heart judge what the Creator has deemed pure and sacred.'"

462.speaker: Sal Ignacius
462.text: "He was referring to love between a man and woman. 'As the land craves the rain, so too are husband and wife drawn together by divine design.'"

463.speaker: Sal Ignacius
463.text: "As Wruhec wrote, 'Both man and woman are pillars of creation, bearing equal strength, wisdom and right to the world's bounties.'"

464.speaker: Jorga Azmal
464.text: "Not violence. As Wruhec wrote, 'One must hone the discipline of the body as well as the spirit to guard and guide the virtues bestowed by the Divine.'"

466.speaker: Sal Ignacius
466.text: "It is no secret that the majority of Wruhecism leaders regard Golcondism as a taint on our religion."

467.speaker: Jorga Azmal
467.text: "A taint? Golcondism has millions of practitioners, all of whom would testify that we are following the one true path St. Wruhec laid out for us."

468.speaker: Player_Romus
468.text: "He has a point, Grand Wiseman. Who are we to say that our form of Wruhecism is the only correct one?"

469.speaker: Jorga Azmal
469.text: "Yet: 'For men or women to stray from the role bestowed on them by the Divine is like the sun blazing at night, or the moon at noon.'"

470.speaker: Sal Ignacius
470.text: "Yet 'In the quiet whisper of peace, truth and righteousness take root and flourish.'"

472.speaker: Player_Romus
472.text: "Quotes will get us nowhere, gentlemen. Let's get back to the real world."

473.speaker: Jorga Azmal
473.text: "Yet Wruhec himself would have wanted you to open your doors to us. 'To obstruct a soul from its sacred communion is to stand against God's gift of free will.'"

474.speaker: Player_Romus
474.text: "I do see the wisdom in the Supreme Wiseman's quote."

475.speaker: Player_Romus
475.text: "My Grand Wiseman speaks the truth as always."

476.speaker: Jorga Azmal
476.text: "Freedom of religion is a real concern, Your Majesty."

477.speaker: Narrator
477.text: Both men glared at each other.

478.speaker: Narrator
478.text: Azmal glared at both of us.

479.speaker: Narrator
479.text: A scowl formed on Sal's face.

480.speaker: Player_Romus
480.text: "I still don't understand the importance of these particular sites. Can't you build your own temples in Derdia?"

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "We agree on many other things, Supreme Wiseman. Can we not get around this somehow?"

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "We don't have to agree with each other to practice diplomacy, Supreme Wiseman. Can we not get around this?"

486.speaker: Jorga Azmal
486.text: "This is what Derdians want, Your Majesty. I would be a bad leader if I did not strive to provide it for them."

487.speaker: Jorga Azmal
487.text: "If you do not lift this ban, any relationship Derdia has with Rizia will be strictly transactional in nature. If that."

488.speaker: Jorga Azmal
488.text: "Every Wruhecist should have the right to tread the same ground our saints once did. Especially those Derdians already living in Rizia."

493.speaker: Jorga Azmal
493.text: "But perhaps I can still help you in some small capacity."

497.speaker: Jorga Azmal
497.text: "But first, we must discuss your so-called 'blasphemy law'."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "I have allowed your words to poison me for long enough, Grand Wiseman. I am lifting our blasphemy law." [-4 Authority]

499.speaker: Jorga Azmal
499.text: "Tell me. Why have you come here? What is it that you want from Derdia?"

501.speaker: Player_Romus
501.text: "We must respect our fellow Wruhecists' beliefs. Supreme Wiseman, my kingdom will do as you ask." [-4 Authority]
501.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 4) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 4  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true)

503.speaker: Sal Ignacius
503.text: "I see, Your Majesty. I will give the order to our Archpriests. We will have Plavo, Benievon and Jales open to Golcondists within a week."

507.speaker: Player_Romus
507.text: "There will be no influx. Our laws are staying the same."

511.speaker: Player_Romus
511.text: "Indeed not. Mr. Azmal, do not presume to order me around like I'm one of your Disciples."

512.speaker: Player_Romus
512.text: "Yes, I agree. I'm sorry, Supreme Wiseman. I cannot do as you ask."

513.speaker: Jorga Azmal
513.text: "There is nothing more we can accomplish today. I beg of you both to get out of my compound."

519.speaker: Narrator
519.text: His eyes darkened. He struggled to keep his expression neutral.

520.speaker: Narrator
520.text: Sal struggled to keep his expression neutral.

521.speaker: Sal Ignacius
521.text: "I'll give the order to our Archpriests. Your people can expect entrance to Plavo, Benievon and Jales within a week."

525.speaker: Jorga Azmal
525.text: "My disciples are compassionate, God-fearing men. You could not become one of them if you tried."

526.speaker: Jorga Azmal
526.text: "I will not forget this act of compassion, Grand Wiseman. My people thank you."

527.speaker: Sal Ignacius
527.text: "Yes, well. May the Lord be with them."

530.speaker: Jorga Azmal
530.text: "Now, Your Majesty. What is it you want?"

533.speaker: Jorga Azmal
533.text: "That will be all for today, Your Majesty."

534.speaker: Jorga Azmal
534.text: "I would now kindly ask you to leave my compound."

539.speaker: Jorga Azmal
539.text: "Is there anything else you would ask of me?"

544.speaker: Player_Romus
544.text: "My only request is that you and the rest of your stray lambs return to the flock. Wruhecism will welcome you back with open arms."
544.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == true)

545.speaker: Jorga Azmal
545.text: "That is all you came here to say?"

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "I have no requests. I only came here so I could see the Silver Garrison for myself."
546.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == true)

556.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
556.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) == false

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "I would not ask anything more of you, Supreme Wiseman."
557.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == true)

558.speaker: Jorga Azmal
558.text: "Now that you've said it, I would kindly ask that you get out of my compound."

559.speaker: Jorga Azmal
559.text: "To gawk at my followers, as you would animals in a zoo?"

560.speaker: Jorga Azmal
560.text: "I hope you got what you came for, then."

565.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
565.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Diplomacy_Derdia_EnableSaltanaMeeting"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) == false

570.speaker: Narrator
570.text: His eyes were fixed on Sal.

579.speaker: Jorga Azmal
579.text: "Is there anything else you would ask of me?"

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "I have no requests. I only came here so I could see the Silver Garrison for myself."
595.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false)

596.speaker: Jorga Azmal
596.text: "You have seen it now. What do you think?"

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "It is beautiful. I wish we had such places back home."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "It's certainly different from the way we live in Rizia. But I understand why people are drawn to it."

602.speaker: Player_Romus
602.text: "I would not ask anything more of you, Supreme Wiseman."
602.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdiaRequests_Morella"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_FightingHelp"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_DerdianRequests_Intermerkopum"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == true) == false)

606.speaker: Sal Ignacius
606.text: "It is not too late to repent, Supreme Wiseman."

607.speaker: Jorga Azmal
607.text: "I could say the same to both of you."

608.speaker: Narrator
608.text: He ushered us out of the room and up the stairs.

609.speaker: Narrator
609.text: He gestured towards the door. Sal stood and looked him in the eye.

614.speaker: Narrator
614.text: He and Sal exchanged short bows.

615.speaker: Narrator
615.text: The sun was still shining brightly as we emerged from the base of the pillar.

616.speaker: Narrator
616.text: Outside, we encountered Titus and Loran. The Derdian fighter was coaching my bodyguard as he swung a wooden practice sword.

617.speaker: Sal Ignacius
617.text: "Should you embrace the one true form of Wruhecism, we will happily invite you to view the restored Plavo Archsanctuary."

621.speaker: Sal Ignacius
621.text: "Should you embrace the one true form of Wruhecism, we will happily welcome you in Benievon and Jales."

623.speaker: Narrator
623.text: On seeing us, both men abruptly stopped what they were doing and snapped to attention.

624.speaker: Narrator
624.text: Outside, Titus was sitting by himself, his eyes on the group of Disciples exercising some distance away.

625.speaker: Narrator
625.text: On seeing me, he rose and snapped to attention.

627.speaker: Narrator
627.text: Azmal stood and gestured towards the door.
627.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Diplomacy_Derdia_EnableSaltanaMeeting"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) == false

628.speaker: Player_Romus
628.text: "But I have another favor to ask."

629.speaker: Narrator
629.text: He kept a smile on his face.

630.speaker: Jorga Azmal
630.text: "This is as far as my goodwill goes. I beg you, do not test it."

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "Splendid. That was all I wanted from you, anyway."

632.speaker: Jorga Azmal
632.text: "You are a humble man, King Romus."

633.speaker: Player_Romus
633.text: "The Lord will smile on what we have accomplished today."

635.speaker: Narrator
635.text: We stood and made our way back up the stairs.

639.speaker: Narrator
639.text: The sun was still shining brightly as we emerged from the base of the pillar.

640.speaker: Narrator
640.text: Outside, we encountered Titus and Loran. The Derdian fighter was coaching my bodyguard as he swung a wooden practice sword.

641.speaker: Narrator
641.text: Outside, Titus was sitting by himself, his eyes on the group of Disciples exercising some distance away.

643.speaker: Narrator
643.text: On seeing us, both men abruptly stopped what they were doing and snapped to attention.

644.speaker: Narrator
644.text: On seeing me, he rose and snapped to attention.

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "Yes, we've done all we've set out to do."

648.speaker: Player_Romus
648.text: "Not so fast. I want to see what he's teaching you."

651.speaker: Narrator
651.text: Titus began swinging the sword in a slow, graceful figure eight pattern, then unexpectedly thrust it forward.

652.speaker: Narrator
652.text: Azmal reached out his hand to me.

653.speaker: Jorga Azmal
653.text: "You are welcome back to the Garrison anytime, Your Majesty."

654.speaker: Player_Romus
654.text: "And you are welcome at Palas Rezna, once my country is again at peace."

658.speaker: Player_Romus
658.text: "And you are welcome at Palas Rezna."

663.speaker: Narrator
663.text: He stepped back with a laugh.

664.speaker: Jorga Azmal
664.text: "A kiss is an intimate gesture between warriors, Your Majesty. We Derdians shake hands with our allies like everyone else."

665.speaker: Narrator
665.text: The sounds of sung hymns and clashing swords accompanied us as we made our way out of the compound.

667.speaker: Jorga Azmal
667.text: "Keep welcoming Golcondists to Rizia, and communities will sprout up like sunflowers."

668.speaker: Jorga Azmal
668.text: "The Golcondist way is not for everyone. But for those who follow it, it is everything."

672.speaker: Player_Romus
672.text: "Yes, we've gotten what we came for."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "Not so fast. I want to see what he's teaching you."

681.speaker: Narrator
681.text: Titus swung the wooden sword over his head in a graceful figure eight pattern.

682.speaker: Jorga Azmal
682.text: "Ah, the Anata Strike. The piercing of universal truth through the cycle of infinity."

683.speaker: Jorga Azmal
683.text: "Ah, the Anata Strike. The piercing of universal truth through the cycle of infinity."

684.speaker: Player_Romus
684.text: "It is not too late to repent, Supreme Wiseman."

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "I hope to see you in Porte Drazon soon."

692.speaker: Narrator
692.text: He quickly stepped back in outrage.

696.speaker: Jorga Azmal
696.text: "I hope I was able to help you in some way."

697.speaker: Jorga Azmal
697.text: "I am sorry that I could not provide you with the help you seek."

698.speaker: Narrator
698.text: He nodded and came over to join us.

699.speaker: Jorga Azmal
699.text: "I hope you will acknowledge the universal truth yourself one day, Your Majesty."

700.speaker: Narrator
700.text: Azmal extended his hand to me.

701.speaker: Narrator
701.text: Shock blossomed on his face, slowly replaced with a dawning realization.

702.speaker: Narrator
702.text: He shook it off with a laugh and took a step backwards.

704.speaker: Jorga Azmal
704.text: "Please don't mock our sacred traditions, Your Majesty."

708.speaker: Jorga Azmal
708.text: "Please don't mock our sacred traditions, Your Majesty."

709.speaker: Narrator
709.text: Shock blossomed on his face, slowly replaced with a dawning realization.

710.speaker: Narrator
710.text: He shook it off and took a step backwards.

712.speaker: Sal Ignacius
712.text: "But of course, so is most of Golcondism..."

713.speaker: Narrator
713.text: Azmal cleared his throat. We and the Disciples stopped speaking.

714.speaker: Jorga Azmal
714.text: "As His Majesty has declared, so it will be. The King of Rizia will duel against my champion."

715.speaker: Jorga Azmal
715.text: "Each fighter will now have five minutes to prepare."

716.speaker: Narrator
716.text: Loran nodded his assent and walked away. He knelt on a patch of grass and raised his arms skyward in prayer, his face a mask of concentration.

717.speaker: Player_Romus
717.text: "Does the Lord have any tips for me, Grand Wiseman?"

720.speaker: Narrator
720.text: My bodyguard spoke in a near-whisper.

721.speaker: Titus Gordion
721.text: "From the exercises I saw earlier, I noticed a slight weakness on this man's right side. So punch with your left arm if you can."

722.speaker: Narrator
722.text: Sal shook his head. He spoke in a near-whisper.

723.speaker: Sal Ignacius
723.text: "God has nothing to do with what's happening here."

724.speaker: Narrator
724.text: The Supreme Wiseman stepped between us.

725.speaker: Narrator
725.text: A short while later, another gong sounded. The Disciples formed a tight circle around me and the man Jorga Azmal had called Loran.

726.speaker: Jorga Azmal
726.text: "The duel will last 10 minutes, or until one opponent acknowledges the other's superior skill in combat. Should a fighter draw blood, the duel will be called off immediately, its results void before the Lord."

727.speaker: Jorga Azmal
727.text: "You will bow to one another, and the duel will commence."

728.speaker: Narrator
728.text: He stepped back into the circle. He and the Disciples began a slow, deep-voiced chant in Derdian as Loran and I bowed to each other.

729.speaker: Narrator
729.text: The moment we began sparring, it was obvious I was outmatched.

730.speaker: Sal Ignacius
730.text: "I confess that I do not know what to expect, Your Majesty. I have studied Golcondist compounds like these excessively, but never been allowed inside."

734.speaker: Player_Romus
734.text: "The Derdians must be happy that Rizia has adopted a more tolerant stance towards their religion."

736.speaker: Player_Romus
736.text: "Rizia considers their religion blasphemous. We can't expect a warm welcome."

737.speaker: Player_Romus
737.text: "Forget their communities. I want their weaponry."

741.speaker: Player_Romus
741.text: "Let's hope it's a quick visit. I can smell the heresy from here."

745.speaker: Player_Romus
745.text: "It's an honor to be amongst our Golcondist brothers and sisters."

749.speaker: Sal Ignacius
749.text: "I do not approve of their warrior culture. But it may indeed be useful in our struggle against Pales."

750.speaker: Sal Ignacius
750.text: "Yes, we have gone far to appease them. Perhaps too far."

751.speaker: Sal Ignacius
751.text: "Never. I still dream of the day when our brethren return to the fold."

752.speaker: Sal Ignacius
752.text: "Even if we tolerated Golcondists, I suspect the Derdians would still not be satisfied."

753.speaker: Sal Ignacius
753.text: "Do not be so dismissive, Your Majesty. They may yet be convinced to return to the fold."

754.speaker: Player_Romus
754.text: "I am surprised you studied a religion that you despise so much."

755.speaker: Sal Ignacius
755.text: "I do not despise the Golcondists, Your Majesty. I still have hope that they will return to the fold."

756.speaker: Sal Ignacius
756.text: "It is they who should be honored to receive a visit from true Wruhecists."

757.speaker: Narrator
757.text: The heavy gates swung open, and a group of Azmal's guards ushered us inside.

758.speaker: Narrator
758.text: The Garrison's grounds were much larger than I would have guessed -- almost the size of Porte Drazon's Old Town.

759.speaker: Narrator
759.text: A gleaming silver pillar rose up from the center, surrounded by a cluster of administrative and religious buildings. Greenhouses, storage silos and living quarters lined the perimeter, separated from the inner circle by a clear natural stream.

760.speaker: Narrator
760.text: The first residents we saw were women in identical white dresses, drawing water from the stream and carrying baskets of vegetables to and from the greenhouses.

761.speaker: Sal Ignacius
761.text: "The Disciples. They practice purification of the spirit through strict martial arts regimens."

762.speaker: Player_Romus
762.text: "I bet Titus could take them all on."

763.speaker: Titus Gordion
763.text: "Not by the sound of it, Your Majesty."

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "I know a few Palesians whose spirit they could purify."

765.speaker: Sal Ignacius
765.text: "Derdia's famed mercenaries are indeed Disciples. If undertaken in the service of a cause they align with, their work counts as progress towards their spiritual ascendance."

771.speaker: Sal Ignacius
771.text: "Hard at work, I expect. They make up the majority of Azmal's council."

772.speaker: Sal Ignacius
772.text: "Adepts work mainly in the spiritual and intellectual realm. They make up the majority of Azmal's council."

776.speaker: Narrator
776.text: We emerged into the center of the Garrison. In front of the pillar was a training ground the size of a football field, flanked on either side by white marble temples.

777.speaker: Narrator
777.text: On it, some four dozen men were engaged in combat drills. Titus watched in open admiration as they executed a complex choreography of strikes, blocks and counterattacks, each punctuated by a forceful cry.

778.speaker: Narrator
778.text: Jorga Azmal, dressed in the same robes I'd seen him wear at the Alliance of Nations, stepped out from their midst.

779.speaker: Narrator
779.text: His smile curdled as he turned to Sal.

783.speaker: Narrator
783.text: With a smile, he turned to Sal.

784.speaker: Sal Ignacius
784.text: "Likewise, Supreme Wiseman. Will your Disciples be treating us to a prayer ceremony?"

785.speaker: Jorga Azmal
785.text: "A pleasure to finally meet you, Grand Wiseman."

786.speaker: Jorga Azmal
786.text: "For this special occasion, I had something different in mind. A traditional Derdian Duel of Generosity."

788.speaker: Player_Romus
788.text: "I was hoping for a respite from fighting. May we pray instead?"

789.speaker: Player_Romus
789.text: "I would rather not start things off with a fight. Let us pray instead."

791.speaker: Narrator
791.text: He lowered his head and motioned for the Disciples to kneel.

792.speaker: Jorga Azmal
792.text: "A Duel of Generosity is not a mere 'fight', Your Majesty. But as you wish."

796.speaker: Jorga Azmal
796.text: "You are familiar with our custom? Even better."

797.speaker: Jorga Azmal
797.text: "No weapons, no bloodshed. Each leader represented by a champion of his choosing."

798.speaker: Sal Ignacius
798.text: "I have read of this ceremony, Your Majesty. It need not be you who participates."

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "A duel? Only if you are prepared to lose."

802.speaker: Narrator
802.text: Azmal bowed his head. He motioned for his Disciples to kneel.

803.speaker: Jorga Azmal
803.text: "Do you have a specific prayer in mind, Your Majesty?"

805.speaker: Narrator
805.text: Azmal and Sal looked at me expectantly.

807.speaker: Player_Romus
807.text: "I do not. But my Grand Wiseman has a few words prepared."

812.speaker: Player_Romus
812.text: "Dearly beloved, we have gathered here today to get through this thing called life."

813.speaker: Player_Romus
813.text: "If I only could, I'd make a deal with God, and I'd get Him to swap our places."

815.speaker: Sal Ignacius
815.text: "O Lord, bless the blasphemers, for they too stand beneath the canopy of your boundless compassion."

816.speaker: Narrator
816.text: He raised his head to look directly at Azmal.

817.speaker: Sal Ignacius
817.text: "In their defiance, may they find the road to enlightenment, and in your benevolence, may they be guided back to the sanctuary of truth."

818.speaker: Jorga Azmal
818.text: "May our hands be steady and our aim be true as we strive to restore the balance of justice you have set forth. Let our struggle be righteous in your eyes, and our victories a testament to Your guiding light."

820.speaker: Jorga Azmal
820.text: "O Sovereign of the Heavens, who arms the faithful with courage, bless our crusade as we march beneath the banner of your sacred decree."

821.speaker: Narrator
821.text: The two holy men exchanged puzzled looks.

825.speaker: Player_Romus
825.text: "God, grant us the serenity to accept the things we cannot change, the courage to change the things we can, and the wisdom to know the difference."
825.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Religious"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PersonalValues_FellOffWagon"] == false)

826.speaker: Player_Romus
826.text: "O Sovereign of the Heavens, who arms the faithful with courage..."

829.speaker: Narrator
829.text: He looked slowly at Sal, then at me.

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "O eternal spirit of peace and wisdom..."

835.speaker: Narrator
835.text: The two holy men exchanged smiles.

836.speaker: Narrator
836.text: Sal mouthed the words along with me as I finished the prayer. Azmal eyed me sternly.

837.speaker: Narrator
837.text: Azmal mouthed the words along with me as I finished the prayer.

838.speaker: Player_Romus
838.text: "God, show me the way, because the Devil's trying to break me down. The only thing that I pray is that my feet don't fail me now."

842.speaker: Sal Ignacius
842.text: "I believe His Majesty was quoting one of St. Wruhec's more obscure disciples."

843.speaker: Jorga Azmal
843.text: "Not what I would have selected. But thank you, Grand Wiseman."

844.speaker: Sal Ignacius
844.text: "Not what I would have selected. But thank you, Supreme Wiseman."

847.speaker: Jorga Azmal
847.text: "You wanted to talk, did you not? Let us talk."

854.speaker: Narrator
854.text: The hand-to-hand combat training I'd received in the military was useless against his technique.

858.speaker: Narrator
858.text: The closest thing I'd received to combat training was a few fencing lessons as a teen. More often than not, I skipped them to spend time with Pabel.

862.speaker: Narrator
862.text: The closest thing I'd received to combat training was a few fencing lessons as a teen. Using my fists felt foreign to me.

863.speaker: Narrator
863.text: Loran moved with a fluid unpredictability. His blows seemed to come out of nowhere, but landed with tactical precision.

864.speaker: Narrator
864.text: Yet somehow, miraculously, I was holding my own against the Derdian fighter.

868.speaker: Player_Romus
868.text: "Oh, come on! Is that all you've got?"

871.speaker: Narrator
871.text: We continued sparring, Loran mostly dodging my blows with ease but occasionally allowing one or two to land.

872.speaker: Narrator
872.text: We continued sparring. Loran's blows began landing a little harder, but I was still able to get a hit or two in.

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "Stop holding back! Show me how a real Disciple fights!"

874.speaker: Player_Romus
874.text: "You're not actually that tough, are you?"

876.speaker: Narrator
876.text: Loran smiled uncomfortably. He stepped back and performed a flashy spin kick that missed my face by just a few centimeters.

877.speaker: Player_Romus
877.text: "FUCK YOUR GOD AND HIT ME! THE KING COMMANDS IT!"

878.speaker: Narrator
878.text: Shock mixed with rage on the Derdian's face. His fist felt like a brick as it connected with the side of my face.

879.speaker: Narrator
879.text: Loran didn't respond. He kept fighting much the same as before.

880.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
880.text: Hit him while he's off guard.

881.speaker: Narrator
881.text: He took it on the ribcage with grace and allowed himself to collapse to the ground, holding up both hands in a sign of concession.

882.speaker: Narrator
882.text: A searing jolt of pain radiated through my skull. I collapsed to the ground.

886.speaker: Narrator
886.text: I allowed myself to fall to the ground, holding my hands up in a sign of concession.

887.speaker: Narrator
887.text: Azmal signaled for the circle to stop chanting. He gleefully applauded.

889.speaker: Jorga Azmal
889.text: "You fought beautifully, Your Majesty. This bodes well for our two countries."

890.speaker: Jorga Azmal
890.text: "And you, my champion. You will make a fine Adept."

891.speaker: Jorga Azmal
891.text: "The Lord has blessed us with a beautiful fight. Very well done, Your Majesty."

892.speaker: Jorga Azmal
892.text: "Loran, you may not have won, but you are still my champion. You will make a fine Adept."

894.speaker: Narrator
894.text: Blood came out of my mouth as I spoke. My tooth had scraped against the inside of my cheek.

895.speaker: Narrator
895.text: The chanting ceased as Azmal rushed to my side.

896.speaker: Player_Romus
896.text: "It was my fault. I shouldn't have taunted him."

898.speaker: Jorga Azmal
898.text: "I admit I was shocked at your disrespect, Your Majesty. But a true Golcondist does not give in to his emotions so easily."

899.speaker: Jorga Azmal
899.text: "Redemption may often be found through pain, Your Majesty. Though I admit I was shocked at your show of disrespect."

900.speaker: Player_Romus
900.text: "Your man is a brute. He does not deserve to become an Adept."

901.speaker: Jorga Azmal
901.text: "Your behavior was most disrespectful, Your Majesty. But he should have had the moral strength to resist."

904.speaker: Narrator
904.text: A Disciple ran over with a medical kit. Once my wound was cleaned and dressed, Azmal helped me to my feet.

906.speaker: Jorga Azmal
906.text: "You have failed today's challenge, my champion. Your ascension will come another day."

912.speaker: Narrator
912.text: After a lengthy drive up steep, curving roads, our motorcade parked just outside the Garrison's gates. Titus and I met Sal as we exited our respective vehicles.

913.speaker: Narrator
913.text: The ten minutes were almost up. My opponent turned his back briefly to prepare for his next move.

915.speaker: Player_Romus
915.text: "Lo, for He did say: Keep running up that road, running up that hill, running up that building."

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "Electric word, life. It means forever, and that's a mighty long time. But I'm here to tell you, there's something else."

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "There's nothing I can do now to right my wrongs. I want to talk with God, but I'm afraid, because we haven't spoke in so long."

918.speaker: Narrator
918.text: My dealings with Derdia were far from over. But I wondered if I would ever see the Silver Garrison again.

922.speaker: Narrator
922.text: I knew that I would never see the Silver Garrison again.
922.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Diplomacy_Derdia_EnableSaltanaMeeting"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_DerdianMercenaries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] > 0) == false

931.speaker: Player_Romus
931.text: "I know a few Wehzeks whose spirit they could purify."

933.speaker: Sal Ignacius
933.text: "I have been looking forward to it, Supreme Wiseman. Shall I lead us in a Wruhecist prayer ceremony?"

934.speaker: Sal Ignacius
934.text: "I have faith they can still be saved."

939.speaker: Player_Romus
939.text: "I hope Azmal's men didn't give you any trouble while we were gone."

942.speaker: Jorga Azmal
942.text: "It is time for you to leave, Your Majesty. We have done all we set out to do."

965.speaker: Player_Romus
965.text: "Much as I would like to lift the ban, I currently lack the resources to pass such an impactful piece of legislature."

966.speaker: Narrator
966.text: He looked at me as if trying to judge whether I was serious.

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "I'm willing to negotiate on this point. But only if what you're willing to offer is worth the potential loss of Zille."

971.speaker: Jorga Azmal
971.text: "I cannot promise that. This is a question of basic humanity. As a Wruhecist, you should understand."

975.speaker: Jorga Azmal
975.text: "Your government's tolerance of illegal substances goes against St. Wruhec's teachings that a devout soul must be pure in both mind and body."
975.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_EqualPayMenWomen"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Drugs_Banned"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false)

979.speaker: Jorga Azmal
979.text: "I am puzzled that men in your country are still forbidden from expressing love for one another. To me, this is among the most basic of rights."
979.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_EqualPayMenWomen"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true)

980.speaker: Jorga Azmal
980.text: "Of course, your decision to remove Wruhecism as Rizia's official state religion angered many in my country."
980.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_EqualPayMenWomen"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_StateReligion_Wruhecism"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true) == false)

981.speaker: Sal Ignacius
981.text: "That is a false interpretation, Supreme Wiseman. In the right quantities, such substances can--"

982.speaker: Jorga Azmal
982.text: "Please. I am not trying to start an argument."
